resources.string: Lets WardYou apply the app usage limits and blocked websites set by the guardian (closes blocked apps, apps outside allowed hours, or blocked sites in the browser). To block sites, it only reads the address shown in the browser\'s address bar — never page content, passwords, or messages — and nothing leaves the device.
This device is protected by your family.

Prevents WardYou from being uninstalled or disabled without the guardians knowing. It never wipes data or controls passwords.
If you turn this off, WardYou\'s protection can be removed from this device and your guardians will be notified.
